general.description: NASA CRM wing alone (AIAA ADODG Case 4 baseline), SA-noft2: M 0.85, alpha 2.2 deg, Re 5e6 per mean aerodynamic chord

domain.notes: Lyu, Kenway and Martins' 26-block grids (Mendeley 10.17632/7jnyjdbvf9.1, CC BY 4.0; data/grids/README.md), in mean aerodynamic chords; patches named by the file's families: wall, far, sym. Reference area, chord and moment point as in Lyu et al. (2014).

freestream.notes: The benchmark is at CL = 0.5; no angle is published for the wing alone. 2.2 deg is an estimate (CRM wing-body solutions reach CL 0.5 near 2.3-2.4 deg). The temperature only sets Sutherland's ratio (Re is given): as the ONERA M6.
